trailhead.label: Car park by the church in Stuls, the board’s start

cautions: Most of the loop is on a quiet tarred farm road with hairpins, shared with cars and tractors: lead on and keep to the side.
About 120 m on the Stuls road near the village: keep your dog close on a short lead.
Meadows beside the road are farmed and closed to dogs in Moos in Passeier in the growing season: keep to the road and path.
No water point is listed on this walk: carry enough for you and your dog.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.
